issue_request: FHIR-26906 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to add search parameters for Location.form and Location.mode so systems can discover total beds at a Location; it explicitly did not add available-bed counting semantics.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit 3bcf58592991dce0f3e27051f0c3009890f3bacc added both Location-form and Location-mode SearchParameter entries. Location-mode was applied correctly, but Location-form had id, path, URL, description, type, and expression for Location.form while its code was mistakenly copied as characteristic.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes location=Location, and the Location StructureDefinition contains active Location.mode and Location.form elements. PA Confluence minutes for 2023-04-05 reference FHIR-26906 and defer vote details to the Jira ticket. No Zulip discussion or later Applied/Published Jira decision was found that changes the Location.form/Location.mode search-parameter decision. FHIR-55300 is a later Resolved - change required value-set migration issue and does not affect this search-parameter code.
reconciliation: Changed source/location/bundle-Location-search-params.xml so the Location-form SearchParameter code is form. No other Location search parameters or element definitions were changed.
